name: krp-core
description: KRP core: the geometry shared by Kaleidohedra and Rhombiverse (by DICTO). Plain ES modules, no dependencies, no build step.

scripts.verify: for s in packing pyrochlore quasicrystal rhombohedra shells roof-fold nets dicto-fcc; do node scripts/verify-$s.mjs || exit 1; done
